implemented.queries: New policy accepts 0-3 supplied visual queries. One or two pass through existing scalar discovery fields; three retain the existing object representation. No padding, deletion, translation or hard-filter promotion. English, length, uniqueness and modality constraints remain.
implemented.keyed_review: Classification and same-frame checks are validated for complete unique integer IDs, then copied into program order. Original responses and status/basis are preserved. Missing, duplicated, unknown, boolean IDs, extra fields and wrong frames remain rejected. Creative scene/Need order is untouched.
implemented.preference_notes: New visual policy permits an empty string. Field presence/type remain required; no invented acceptance. Required evidence and verdict semantics are unchanged.
implemented.recovery: Plan-pinned revision propagates through compilation, cache, Material request, raw compact_results, deterministic normalization digests and cold report reconstruction. Legacy intake5 and visual-requirements1 retain prior rules.

validation.evidence_limit: Real internal modules with deterministic external replies. Not a full repository regression, real-model reliability estimate, Formal Planning qualification or MP4 acceptance. Do not add overlapping test counts.

next: Keep this validated implementation. Reconcile the previously unknown original upstream request before any further real dispatch; do not repeat this implementation, query account quota automatically, reset budgets or treat software evidence as real video acceptance.
